warnings.message: 'Recover Due Work and SLA' creates a new httpHeaderAuth credential. Set genericAuthType to 'httpTemplatedCustomAuth' instead — `Authorization: Bearer <token>` becomes the template {"headers":{"Authorization":"Bearer {{api_key}}"}} — or credential setup will reject it. Plain generic types are only for reusing an existing credential.

'Send Protected Wakeup' creates a new httpHeaderAuth credential. Set genericAuthType to 'httpTemplatedCustomAuth' instead — `Authorization: Bearer <token>` becomes the template {"headers":{"Authorization":"Bearer {{api_key}}"}} — or credential setup will reject it. Plain generic types are only for reusing an existing credential.

'Acknowledge Wakeup' creates a new httpHeaderAuth credential. Set genericAuthType to 'httpTemplatedCustomAuth' instead — `Authorization: Bearer <token>` becomes the template {"headers":{"Authorization":"Bearer {{api_key}}"}} — or credential setup will reject it. Plain generic types are only for reusing an existing credential.
'Send Protected Wakeup' parameter 'url' uses $json.resume_url but no predecessor outputs this field.
'Wakeup Accepted' parameter 'conditions.conditions[0].leftValue' uses $json.statusCode but no predecessor outputs this field.
'Acknowledge Wakeup' parameter 'jsonBody' uses $('Due Wakeups').item.json.scope_id but 'Due Wakeups' doesn't output this field.
